## 97dd5f3c96b9

**Reproduced generator defect: overlapping aligned-pair segments overwrite an original marker.**

With seed `0`, sample index `1`, difficulty `easy`, and no overrides, the generator emits a validator-clean 7×9 grid containing color-7 markers at `(3,4)` and `(3,7)` and color-4 markers at `(3,5)` and `(3,8)`. The two collinear segments overlap at `(3,5..7)`. The canonical program paints color 4 and then color 7, so its output changes the original color-4 marker at `(3,5)` to 7. A natural marker-preserving rival—connect each pair but restore every original nonzero endpoint—fits all 3/3 canonical pairs and differs on this generated input at exactly that cell.

The input passes the target's `self_check` and was emitted by the documented default domain. Exact seed metadata, input, canonical Racket output, rival output, hashes, and the disagreement cell are in `checks/audit/97dd5f3c96b9/case.json`; the authority transcript is `checks/audit/97dd5f3c96b9/racket.json`. No fix was made because this was audit-only.

triage.reason: Both adversarial findings, source-bound reproducers and notes retained; unrelated audit targets unchanged.
